thread:
Lena (Marketing): Quick thread to nail landing copy + launch posts for the tri-mode push. Focus: webinar, benchmarks, and lead routing.
Ravi (Growth): goal alignment: hosted -> self-serve signups, dedicated -> demo requests, private -> security contact. Webinar to funnel mid-market Dedicated leads.
Priya (PM): webinar date tentatively next Tue 10am PT. Speakers: Priya + Kai (infra) + Casey (customer ops). We'll need 1 slide showing latency/cost tradeoffs across modes.
Eli (Design): I'll mock hero locks. Proposed hero lines:
- Hosted: "Ship LLMs fast — self-serve API"
- Dedicated: "Guaranteed throughput. Predictable cost."
- Private: "Inference inside your network. Compliant."
Lena (Marketing): tweak Hosted to be more benefit-led: "Ship LLM features in hours." Dedicated keep but shorter: "Predictable throughput". Private: "Deploy behind your VPC." 
Ravi (Growth): lead routing: include a hidden select on the webinar form "Which deployment are you evaluating?" values: hosted/dedicated/private. map to utm_campaign=tri-launch and tag leads accordingly.
Noah (EngOps): webhook mapping ready. example tag: "interest:dedicated". Also propose a short footnote on the landing: "Dedicated customers get 99.9% uptime SLA" 
Priya (PM): careful on SLA claim until contract signed. change to "SLA-backed options available".
Lena (Marketing): draft social post A: "Were launching a tri-mode inference strategy: Hosted, Dedicated, and Private. One API, predictable performance. Join our webinar for benchmarks and migration tips. <link>" Too corporate?
Ravi (Growth): shorten: "One API. Any deployment. See latency & cost benchmarks live: <link>" Use for X. LinkedIn can be slightly longer.
Eli (Design): CTA test: "Register  See Benchmarks" vs "Register  Get Migration Playbook". I'll wire the variant IDs.
Noah (EngOps): will accept the two CTAs. webhooks route registrant variant_id -> growth A/B dashboard.
notify-bot: Reminder set for Tuesday 2023-03-14 10:00:00 PT  Webinar prep.
Lena (Marketing): landing microcopy v1: "Ship features fast with Redwood Inference. Use one consistent API across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. Choose Hosted for rapid self-serve launches, Dedicated for predictable throughput, or Private to keep data inside your VPC. Register for our webinar to see benchmark demos and migration playbooks." 
Ravi (Growth): good. cut one sentence for hero. hero variant: "One API. Any deployment. Predictable performance." 
Priya (PM): logging action items: 1) Eli upload hero comps to assets 2) Noah finalize webhook field slugs 3) Ravi draft 2 social posts for X & LinkedIn 4) Lena push copy to staging. reconvene Tue morning for a dry run.
Lena (Marketing): thanks everyone  uploading now. sending staging link in 15.
